briefdescription.para: Replace every call to F using ReplaceCall, and then erase F.

detaileddescription.para: If there is an error replacing a call, we emit a diagnostic and return true.

briefdescription.para: Create a cast between a target("dx") type and dx.types.Handle, which is intended to be removed by the end of lowering.

detaileddescription.para: This is used to allow lowering of ops which need to change their return or argument types in a piecemeal way - we can add the casts in to avoid updating all of the uses or defs, and by the end all of the casts will be redundant.

briefdescription.para: Lower dx.resource.handlefrombinding intrinsics depending on the shader model and taking into account binding information from DXILResourceBindingAnalysis.
